portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：自身免疫性胰腺炎是一种日益被认可的慢性胰腺炎变体，根据国际共识诊断标准分为 2 种亚型：1 型，与 IgG4（免疫球蛋白 G4）相关疾病相关；2 型，胰腺特异性疾病 临床提示：自身免疫性胰腺炎是一种日益被认可的慢性胰腺炎变体，根据国际共识诊断标准分为 2 种亚型： 1 型，与 IgG4（免疫球蛋白 G4）相关
portal_hypertension.abstract: Autoimmune pancreatitis is an increasingly recognized variant of chronic pancreatitis, classified into 2 subtypes by the international consensus diagnostic criteria: type 1, associated with IgG4 (Immunoglobulin G4)-related disease, and type 2, a pancreas-specific disorder often linked to inflammatory bowel disease. The diagnosis is based on histology, imaging of pancreatic parenchyma/ducts, serology (serum IgG4 levels), other organ involvement or extrapancreatic manifestations, and response to the steroid treatment. portal_hypertension.title: FIGThe Efficacy and Safety of Clip-Assisted Endoscopic Cyanoacrylate Injection for Gastric Varices: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Abuelazm M, Hawas Y, Hamed BM
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：传统的内镜氰基丙烯酸酯注射（Con-ECI）是一种有效的治疗方法，但它与再出血和全身异位栓塞的显着风险相关。 临床提示：胃静脉曲张（GV）出血是门静脉高压症的严重并发症。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Bleeding from gastric varices (GVs) is a severe complication of portal hypertension. Conventional endoscopic cyanoacrylate injection (Con-ECI) is an effective treatment, but it is associated with significant risks of rebleeding and systemic ectopic embolism. Clip-assisted ECI (Clip-ECI), where clips are deployed before glue injection, has been developed to mitigate these risks, but its efficacy remains debatable. A comprehensive search of PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Scopus was conducted for studies up to August 2025. The primary outcomes were all-cause rebleeding and ectopic embolism. Secondary outcomes included variceal obliteration, mortality, and procedure-related complications. R...

portal_hypertension.title: Accuracy of splenic stiffness measurement for predicting clinically significant varices in children with portal hypertension: a systematic review and diagnostic test accuracy meta-analysis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Kumar A, Patel RK, Kumar Krishnegowda V
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：评估脾硬度测量 (SSM) 对门脉高压 (PHTN) 儿童（包括非肝硬化门脉高压 (NCPH) 和慢性肝病 (CLD)）临床显着静脉曲张 (CSV) 检测的诊断准确性。 临床提示：系统审查和诊断测试准确性荟萃分析。
portal_hypertension.abstract: To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of splenic stiffness measurement (SSM) for detecting clinically significant varices (CSV) in children with portal hypertension (PHTN), including non-cirrhotic portal hypertension (NCPH) and chronic liver disease (CLD). Systematic review and diagnostic test accuracy meta-analysis. MEDLINE (via PubMed), Embase and Scopus were searched from inception to 31 July 2025. No language or time limitations were applied. We included prospective and retrospective studies which had children (<18 years) with clinically, radiologically, biochemically or histologically diagnosed PHTN. portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝脏相关的危险因素... 临床提示：可改变的因素可能会影响肝硬化和门脉高压相关出血（PHB）患者的预后。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Modifiable factors may influence prognosis in patients with cirrhosis and portal hypertension-related bleeding (PHB). This study characterized metabolic and hematological profiles during and after PHB and evaluated their impact on liver-related events and mortality. Observational, single-center, retrospective cohort study including patients with cirrhosis admitted for PHB and followed for 1 year. Epidemiological, clinical, analytical, and hemodynamic data were collected. Anemia was defined according to World Health Organization criteria, and the hypoalbuminemia threshold was established using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves and the Youden index. portal_hypertension.title: Porto Sinusoidal Vascular Disorder Manifesting as Diffuse Arterio-Portal Fistulae and Portal Hypertension After Donation-After-Circulatory-Death Liver Transplantation.
portal_hypertension.authors: Castleberry DT, Mashal FA, Meek J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：缺血性胆管病 (ICP) 是原位肝移植 (LT) 的一种罕见并发症，在死后捐献 (DCD) 受者中发生率增加，特别是在没有机器灌注的情况下。 临床提示：随着 DCD 利用率的增加，挑战也随之出现。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Ischemic cholangiopathy (ICP) is a rare complication of orthotopic liver transplantation (LT), with an increased incidence in donation-after-circulatory-death (DCD) recipients, particularly without machine perfusion. As DCD utilization increases, challenges arise. We report a rare case of DCD-LT resulting in ICP, complicated by diffuse intrahepatic arterio-portal fistulae (APF) leading to portal hypertension and refractory ascites without any other cause. The candidate was relisted for LT, and the explant revealed diffuse intrahepatic APF and porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder (PSVD) without cirrhosis.
